purpose: Make Works the observable Fruit layer of the project without equating publication, popularity or completion with success.
rule: Every mature Work may declare which center material it transforms, what type of Fruit it is, who it is for, what evidence/claims it carries, and what future Seed/capacity it is intended to create.
evaluation: Completion is output, not automatically Fruit.
Revenue is one consequence, not total value.
A Work that creates reusable skill/knowledge/capacity has reproductive Fruit.
A Work that intensifies dependency, confusion or hidden cost can carry poison-Fruit risk even if successful by a narrow metric.
Negative/failed experiments can be informational Fruit if they reliably close a false path.
handoff: Works receives mature material from owning Rooms; feedback/reception returns to History, Culture and Research rather than silently rewriting canon.
